body.applicability: fx_target_per_source must be strictly positive and as-of compatible; inverse quote uses fx_target_per_source = 1 / fx_source_per_target.
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing or non-positive FX rate leaves amount_target unavailable.

body.applicability: Default included: unrestricted cash/equivalents, policy-confirmed highly-liquid current financial investments. Default excluded: restricted cash, strategic/equity-method investments, non-distributable pension/insurance assets, collateral balances, noncurrent financial investments. Noncurrent financial investments are only conditional_included when reliable current value, liquidity, non-strategic character, and reviewed rationale jointly hold.
body.missing_data_behavior: An unresolved component is excluded from the sum and flagged, never silently treated as zero-eligible or fully-eligible.

body.applicability: debt_bridge_component is the exact reverse of whichever EV-ledger basis (lease-exclusive or lease-inclusive) produced enterprise_value; equity_method_adjustment sign is the exact reverse of its EV-ledger entry.
body.expression: Equity_parent = Enterprise_value - D_fin[- L for lease-inclusive basis] - NCI - Pref - JV_adj + C_elig

entries.label: Enterprise value to parent equity value bridge

body.applicability: equity_method_adjustment is only applied via the paired T12 policy; the two ledger forms (direct-component sum and MC + ND_ex sum) must reconcile exactly.
body.expression: EV_ex = MC + D_fin + NCI + Pref + JV_adj - C_elig, equivalently MC + ND_ex + NCI + Pref + JV_adj
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing market_cap_native or net_debt_ex_lease leaves enterprise_value_ex_lease unavailable.

body.applicability: Only pairable with a lease-compatible operating-earnings/FCF/DCF claim (e.g. EBITDAR); an IFRS16 EBITDA numerator is not automatically lease-inclusive-compatible.
body.expression: EV_incl = MC + D_fin + L + NCI + Pref + JV_adj - C_elig = EV_ex + L
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing lease_liability_total leaves enterprise_value_incl_lease unavailable even when enterprise_value_ex_lease is available.

body.applicability: spot_basic_shares_outstanding must be strictly positive and on the same claim/class basis as equity_parent.

entries.label: Equity value per spot basic share

body.applicability: lease_principal_paid must be checked against the CFO reconciliation it came from to prevent double subtraction; missing lease payment is unavailable, never assumed zero.
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing any operand leaves fcf_after_lease unavailable; a negative result is preserved signed, never clamped to zero.

entries.label: After-lease free cash flow (equity), CFO minus capex minus lease principal paid

body.applicability: All five operands must share the same period/currency/scope; lease_principal_paid must be checked against the CFO reconciliation it came from to prevent double subtraction. Same net-income-share proxy attribution as fcf_standard_equity_parent_share -- see that entry's applicability note.
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing any operand leaves fcf_after_lease_parent_share unavailable. total_net_income == 0 (or non-positive) is calculation_blocked, not unavailable. A negative result is preserved signed, never clamped to zero.

entries.label: After-lease free cash flow (equity), parent-attributed via net-income ownership share

body.applicability: CFO and capex must share the same period/currency/scope; capex is a normalized positive outflow.
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing either operand leaves fcf_standard unavailable; a negative result is preserved signed, never clamped to zero.

entries.label: Standard free cash flow (equity), CFO minus capex

body.applicability: All four operands must share the same period/currency/scope. This is a proxy attribution, not a directly disclosed figure: IFRS cash flow statements do not split CFO by ownership the way the P&L splits net income into parent/NCI, so the parent's share of total net income is used as the allocation key. For a company with no noncontrolling interests the ratio is 1 and this is numerically identical to fcf_standard_equity.
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing any operand leaves fcf_standard_parent_share unavailable. total_net_income == 0 (or non-positive) is calculation_blocked, not unavailable, matching this catalog's existing zero/negative-denominator convention (see equity_value_per_spot_basic_share). A negative result is preserved signed, never clamped to zero.

entries.label: Standard free cash flow (equity), parent-attributed via net-income ownership share

body.applicability: Lease liabilities are always excluded here; each ledger component is tagged included/excluded/conditional/unresolved by the source balance sheet.
body.missing_data_behavior: An unresolved required component leaves financial_debt_ex_lease unavailable, never assumed zero.

entries.label: Interest-bearing financial debt excluding lease liabilities

body.applicability: spot_price_per_share must be strictly positive and in the same currency/basis as implied_value_per_share. This is a diagnostic comparison, never a recommendation.
Only used by lease-inclusive net-debt/EV variants.
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing lease disclosure is unavailable, never assumed zero; a company with no separate lease disclosure (e.g. EREGL-like) simply cannot produce a lease-inclusive result, while lease-exclusive results remain unaffected.

body.applicability: Price and share basis must be on a compatible effective date; free-float shares are never the denominator; diluted shares never produce this primary spot market cap.
body.missing_data_behavior: Any missing required operand leaves market_cap_native unavailable; never coerced to zero.

body.applicability: A negative result is canonical net cash; clamping to zero is forbidden.
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing either operand leaves net_debt_ex_lease unavailable.

body.applicability: Postcondition: net_debt_incl_lease - net_debt_ex_lease must equal lease_liability_total exactly; a lease double-counted in another debt line is a blocker.
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing lease_liability_total leaves net_debt_incl_lease unavailable even when net_debt_ex_lease is available.

body.applicability: Same effective date and instrument class basis for both operands; corporate-action coverage must be complete.
body.missing_data_behavior: Missing treasury disclosure is unavailable, never assumed zero. Result <= 0 is calculation_blocked.
